course.title: Text and Unstructured Data for Data Science
course.tagline: Turn Arabic and English text into measurements you can defend: clean and redact a corpus, score sparse, embedding and prompted classifiers on one gold set, test a language model as an annotator and correct the estimates its labels feed
course.description: Participants turn text into measurements they can defend. For the Sada Citizen Voice Centre, a fictional agency receiving complaints in Arabic and English, they normalise Arabic script and dialect spellings, redact personal data, build sparse and embedding-based classifiers, classify and extract fields with a prompted open-weight language model, and treat every model-made label as a measurement: agreement with a human gold set, stability across runs and prompts, gaps between dialects and the bias it carries into estimates. Writing labelling guidelines and adjudication are in DS-311.
course.audience: Specialists. Analysts and data scientists who have completed the level 200 set or can show equivalent work: an analysis or model they built, validated and can explain.
prerequisites: DS-202 Data Acquisition, Preparation and Quality
DS-204 Machine Learning for Tabular Data: Baselines and Validation
Calls a web API from Python and parses JSON
course.format_note: Intensive: 4 teaching days of four sessions and a capstone day, with guided pre-work and a tracked follow-up task

outcomes.text: Prepare a bilingual corpus by normalising script, removing near-duplicates and redacting personal data, given 20,000 raw complaints with mixed scripts and embedded phone numbers
outcomes.evidence: a cleaning script and a profile report with the redaction miss rate

outcomes.text: Implement sparse, embedding-based and prompted classifiers and score them on one held-out gold set, given a training pool and a fixed budget of model calls
outcomes.evidence: results with intervals by language and cost per thousand documents

outcomes.text: Implement schema-constrained field extraction and measure field-level precision and recall, given 500 synthetic inspection reports with reference extractions
outcomes.evidence: an extraction script and a per-field validation report

outcomes.text: Compute a district complaint rate from model labels corrected with a human-labelled sample and compare it with the uncorrected rate, given model labels for all complaints and a 300-document human gold set with measured agreement
outcomes.evidence: a table of naive and corrected rates with intervals

outcomes.text: Evaluate a language model as an annotator and decide whether its labels can feed a downstream estimate, given labels from two prompts and three runs over the gold set
outcomes.evidence: a reliability memo on agreement, stability, dialect gaps and the decision

outcomes.text: Design a text-measurement pipeline for a stakeholder question and defend each measurement choice, given a supplied corpus and a written brief
outcomes.evidence: a repository and report defended live

case_study.name: Sada Citizen Voice Centre
case_study.summary: Sada Citizen Voice Centre is a fictional government centre that receives complaints about municipal services in Modern Standard Arabic, Gulf dialect and English. Participants work on 20,000 synthetic complaints from 12 districts, a 300-document gold set coded by two people, 500 inspection reports and the recorded runs of Fahim, the centre's prompted labelling instruction on an open-weight model: they clean and redact the corpus, compare three classifiers, measure Fahim as an instrument and correct the district complaint rates its labels produce. All data are synthetic and written with a fixed seed; the recorded model runs are synthetic too.

days.label: Capstone
days.title: Capstone: a text measurement defended live
days.subtitle: Each participant defends a text-measurement pipeline in eight minutes, then re-labels ten documents chosen by the assessor and answers questions

capstone.summary: A text-measurement project on a supplied or public corpus, in a public repository whose README reports the gold set, agreement, model and extraction results and a reliability memo; eight-minute defence plus questions
capstone.submission: A link to a public GitHub repository: the cleaning and redaction script with its miss rate, the gold set and agreement, the classifier and extraction results with model and prompt versions, the saved model outputs and run logs, the corrected estimate and the reliability memo, with a lock file and a README that reports all of them; prompts and agent transcripts are committed with it
